# The Definition of Love

> A forthcoming literary novel by David L. Condrey about memory, grief, imagination, and the distance between being loved and being seen.

**Author:** David L. Condrey
**Status:** Forthcoming, 2027
**Language:** English
**Genre:** Literary fiction, contemporary fiction
**Site:** https://dcondrey.github.io/the-definition-of-love/
**Reader list:** open — name and email collected on the site

## About the novel
*The Definition of Love* follows a dying professor, a daughter he cannot remember raising, and a final promise to the woman he loved. It is a literary novel about grief, imagination, and the quiet violence of being disbelieved.

Central question: *How do you prove the existence of someone the world refuses to see?*

Themes: memory, obsession, grief, imagination, perception, love, identity.

## About the author
David L. Condrey is a novelist. *The Definition of Love* is his forthcoming literary novel. His published essays appear on Medium at https://medium.com/@davidcondrey.
